title: Adjacent torsion cardinalities satisfy a quadratic recurrence
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. For each positive integer j write c_j = Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // j • P = 0}. For every natural number m ≥ 2, one has c_(m+1) + c_(m−1) = 2c_m + 2.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (m + 1) • P = 0} + Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // (m - 1) • P = 0} = 2 * Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // m • P = 0} + 2
